thread:
maya: quick thread: sidecarless private installs2 how should control-plane auth reach runtime without injecting secrets?
Tony: options: delegated short-lived tokens from control-plane OR runtime pulls from customer KMS.
Olga: token-delegation is simpler for hosted/dedicated but fails for air-gapped on-prem. need a pull adapter for that case.
Liam: agreed. design idea: default token-exchange for hosted/dedicated; provide a kms-pull adapter for private/on-prem with local cache+refresh.
maya: cache semantics are critical. proposal: cache_ttl, refresh_threshold, background refresh with backoff, and explicit rotation webhook when network path exists.
Tony: also define fail policy: FAIL_OPEN vs FAIL_CLOSED. recommend private default = FAIL_CLOSED, hosted = FAIL_OPEN with alerts.
Olga: add circuit-breaker: after N auth failures in window T, stop attempts and surface 503 + structured error. audit token issuance + rotations.
Liam: config sketch: 
```
auth:
  mode: auto      # token-exchange | kms-pull | auto
  cache_ttl: 5m
  refresh_threshold: 30s
  fail_policy: closed
  rotation_webhook: https://hooks.example/local-rotate
```
Tony: infra: surface per-tenant token metrics + failure rates in console; RBAC: only org-admin may flip fail_policy.
maya: actions: Olga+Liam draft kms-pull adapter API + cache state machine; Tony draft telemetry KPIs; i'll update hosting surface doc.
infra-bot: deploy-check: no blocking issues found. :white_check_mark:
Tony: will add 15m arch-sync to review on Monday.
